To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the data management challenges of Big Data and the cloud can be summarized as follows: (1) data is becoming more and more heterogeneous, (2) data is growing exponentially, (3) data is becoming increasingly distributed, (4) data is becoming available in real-time, (5) data is becoming a first-class citizen in many applications and (6) data is becoming less and less trustworthy.

(1) The cloud is a data management platform; (2) The cloud enables data-driven applications; (3) Cloud data management is about data placement; (4) Cloud data management must be automated; (5) The cloud is about data mobility; (6) Cloud data management needs to be secure.

the key research challenges for Big Data and Cloud computing are: (1) to enable data management systems that can efficiently handle the volume and velocity of Big Data, (2) to enable data sharing in the Cloud, (3) to enable data provenance, (4) to enable privacy-preserving data sharing, (5) to enable data security in the cloud, and (6) to enable data integration and data quality in the cloud.
In summary, our research is concerned with

(i) data management in the Cloud; (ii) data management in Big Data; (iii) data management in hybrid Clouds; (iv) data management in federated Clouds; (v) data management in mobile Clouds; and (vi) data management in social Clouds.
(a) data provenance, (b) data privacy, (c) data security, (d) data quality, (e) data management for scientific data and (f) data management for the Internet of Things.

the following: (i) data management on a large scale; (ii) data management in a distributed environment; (iii) data management in the context of the Cloud; (iv) data management with a focus on the user; (v) data management in an uncertain world, where data is noisy, incomplete, and uncertain; and (vi) data management with an emphasis on data provenance, data quality, and data privacy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the future of data management research is in the cloud, and the future of cloud computing research is in data management.
Big Data and Cloud computing have a profound impact on the way data is managed and that this impact is not yet fully understood and that the impact is still evolving.
data is the new oil and the cloud is the new refinery.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are trying to make data management systems that are more flexible and easier to use.
data management research should be more focused and more relevant for Big Data, Cloud Computing, and the Internet.
the Cloud is a great enabler for Big Data, and that Big Data can be a great enabler to the Cloud.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we need a new generation of research that focuses on data management challenges in Big Data and the cloud.
the Big Data revolution is not just about the technology; it is also about how we use it to make better business decisions.
the data management community needs to develop new techniques for managing data in the cloud, and that these techniques need to take into account the new characteristics and requirements of Big Data.
